Content Creator Job at Scentimental




        
    

        
        Scentimental is a luxury home fragrance and lifestyle brand inspired by nostalgia, travel, and storytelling.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Content Creator

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time
Work arrangement: Hybrid

Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Do you love storytelling, creating engaging content, and bringing brands to life? At Scentimental, we use fragrance to tell stories of travel, culture, memory, and discovery.
	We’re looking for a creative Content Creator to help us bring these stories to life and connect with our growing audience.


What you’ll do


	Create engaging social media content, including Reels, Stories, captions, and short-form videos.
	Translate fragrance, culture, and travel-inspired experiences into compelling brand stories.
	Plan content calendars and support campaigns, product launches, and seasonal collections.
	Capture behind-the-scenes content and showcase our products and brand experiences.
	Track content performance and use insights to improve engagement and reach.


What we’re looking for


	2–5 years of experience in content creation, social media, or digital marketing.
	Strong storytelling, writing, and copywriting skills.
	Experience creating short-form video and social media content.
	Good understanding of social media trends, audience engagement, and content performance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief introductory email to: [email protected] and copy [email protected] using "Social Media Manager" as the subject of the email.

  "description": "OPay is a mobile money platform operated by OPay Digital Services Limited and licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. We believe everyone should be able to enjoy financial and social inclusion, without regard for physical borders, boundaries, or even social status.

OPay is a one-stop mobile-based platform for payment and other important services in your everyday life. Millions of users rely on OPay every day to send and receive money and pay bills.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Events Manager

Job Location: Lagos

About the Role


	We&rsquo;re looking for a Marketing Manager to join our Integrated Marketing &amp; Communications (IMC) team.
	Your main focus will be events: OPay&rsquo;s external and business-led events, and our presence at industry events across different sectors.
	You&rsquo;ll also support wider marketing work across the team.
	We want an all-round marketer who specialises in events, not an event planner only.
	Every event you deliver should meet two goals: a brand goal and a business goal.
	You&rsquo;ll report to the IMC Lead, who sets the overall direction.
	You&rsquo;ll own the events function and support other marketing projects within that direction.


What you&rsquo;ll do
Events and business goals:


	Link every event to a clear brand goal and a clear business goal.
	Plan events against the yearly events budget, and show what each event returns for its cost.
	Turn event requests into clear briefs: goals, audience, budget, timeline and KPIs.


External and business-led events:


	Plan and deliver OPay&rsquo;s own external events, from concept to post-event report.
	Run events end to end: run of show, guest lists, branding, logistics and on-site management.
	Work with sales, partnerships, brand, creative and PR teams so events support wider business and campaign plans.


Industry events and visibility:


	Find and assess industry events across sectors, such as fintech, banking, retail, tech and SMEs, where OPay should show up.
	Recommend which events to attend, speak at or sponsor, and why.
	Manage OPay&rsquo;s presence at these events: booths, branding, speaking slots and on-site activity.
	Build relationships with event organisers and industry bodies.


Wider marketing support:


	Support the planning and rollout of integrated campaigns across channels.
	Plan and run on-ground activations and BTL work linked to campaigns.
	Support brand partnerships and sponsorships.
	Write briefs for creative, content and production work, and review what comes back.
	Coordinate agencies and partner teams on assigned projects.
	Take on other marketing projects as assigned by the IMC Lead.


Budget and vendors:


	Prepare budgets and cost breakdowns for events and assigned projects.
	Source and manage vendors and agencies in line with company procurement policy.
	Keep clear records of all spend.


Reporting:


	Report on every event and project: results against goals, spend against budget, and brand visibility.
	Share what worked and what to change next time.


Requirements
Must have:


	4&ndash;6 years in marketing, with at least 3 years focused on events, agency, or in-house.
	Has delivered corporate or brand events for 300+ guests.
	Experience managing a brand&rsquo;s presence at industry events, conferences or expos.
	Broad marketing experience: campaigns, activations, partnerships or brand projects.
	Can tie events and campaigns to business results, not just attendance or reach.
	Experience managing budgets and several vendors at once.
	Comfortable working within formal approval and procurement processes.
	Clear, timely written updates and reports.
	Willing to travel and work some evenings and weekends.


Nice to have:


	Experience in fintech, banking, FMCG or telecoms.
	A network of event organisers and industry contacts in Nigeria.
	Experience with sponsorship deals or speaking-slot placements.
	A Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field.

title: Job Openings at Beam Energy Limited
content:
Beam Energy Limited is an Integrated Engineering Solution Provider incorporated in 2003 to provide high quality services in Electrical, Instrumentation, Control, Automation, Telecommunication, Power Infrastructure, Mechanical Fabrication, and Maintenance as well as Global Supply for Oil and Gas, Power, Manufacturing and Construction Sectors of Sub Sahara African region.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Senior E&I Technician

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Maintain regular and continuous interface and working collaboration with the operations and installation subcontractor on all E&I issues/concerns/inputs towards the smooth completion of the E&I installation & construction scope of the project.
	Review all key E&I deliverables from Engineering for the project before they are issued to the client.
	Participate in regular project technical meetings with Engineering and client/client rep. on project technical issues.
	Build, maintain and manage all client/client rep. interfaces on E&I issues and scope for the project. Also act as the interface person between the client E&I Engineer and the engineering design subcontractor.
	Pay regular and frequent site visits to the different project sites to resolve, support and monitor E&I construction and installation activities. (If subcontracted)
	Support the procurement department and the procurement process for all E&I and control packages and units with all required and relevant technical assistance to actively sustain the procurement process for E&I materials for the project.
	Supervise the activities of vendors and subcontractors working on E&I fabrication and installation works for the project.
	Carry out insulation resistance, continuity, earth resistance, and functional tests, and record results accurately.
	Calibrate instruments using approved calibration equipment, maintaining traceable calibration records.
	Perform loop checks, point-to-point verification, and functional testing of related field devices.
	Comply with and enforce permit-to-work (PTW), lock-out/tag-out (LOTO), isolation, working-at-height, and confined-space procedures.
	Ensure work meets the project quality plan, applicable standards, and client requirements.
	Complete daily progress reports, material take-off requests, timesheets, and redline mark-ups for as-built drawings.
	Keep accurate records of tests, calibrations, and inspections for audit and handover.


Requirements


	B.Tech / B.Eng in Electrical/Electronics.
	Trade Test Electrical (Industrial & Domestic) grades 2 & 3 is also an added advantage
	Membership of COREN, NSE or Relevant Professional Body will be of added advantage.
	Experience with upstream, midstream, or downstream facilities (flow stations, gas plants, pipelines, terminals, refineries, or offshore platforms).
	Experience working with international clients and IOCs/NOCs is highly desirable.


Application Closing Date: 12th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Note: only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Project Engineer

Job Location: Ogba - Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
Project Planning:


	Prepares Budget and time schedules for Projects.
	Prepares Project Design Drawings, Shop Drawings and “As Built Drawing
	Ensure Proper handling of Company Tools and Equipment as well as Maintenance.
	Reads and understands Contract Documents


Financial Management:


	Monitors and controls allotted Resources for effective, efficient and timely service delivery.
	Adheres strictly to Cost Monitoring Procedure.
	Liaises with Superior / General Manager to ensure provision of necessary resources for Project Delivery


Project/Site Coordination:


	Provides Technical Evaluation of Sub-contractors and commercial inputs.
	Attends site meetings with Clients and other Contractors on site.
	Ensures compliance with and implementation of Quality Control procedure for all incoming materials.
	Delegates authority and ensures subordinates are adequately engaged.
	Supervise the Technician and Sub-Contractors on site during Installation.
	Ensures cordial relationships with Clients.


Project Reporting:


	Ensures regular preparation and submission of project progress reports on agreed format and at agreed time.
	Creates effective communication and feedback systems for interfaces


Project Monitoring:


	Monitors progress of Projects and resolves all Project matters timely
	Measures Performance of Subordinates


Project Implementation:


	
	Manages unforeseen crisis to ensure successful Project execution
	


Project Design:


	Develops and supervise the draughting of Drawings for Specific Projects
	Develops Bill of Quantities for Projects from shop drawings and from Consultant / Clients drawings for the purpose of tendering .


Tendering:


	Assists in Tendering Processes.
	Provide Technical Support to the Proposal and Business Development Team


Application Closing Date: 28th October, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

3.) Instrumentation and Control Engineer

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities
Instrumentation, Control and Automation:


	Develop and review instrumentation design deliverables: P&ID inputs, instrument index, datasheets, loop diagrams, hook-up drawings, cable schedules, JB schedules, I/O lists, cause & effect diagrams, and control system architecture drawings.
	Size and select field instruments (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical), control valves, PSVs, and actuated valves.
	Participate in HAZID, HAZOP, SIL assessment, and constructability reviews.
	Ensure design compliance with hazardous area classification and protection requirements.
	Develop Instrument Datasheet and System Architecture as well as Bill of Materials
	Field Instrument Integration and Panel Installation Supervision
	Define functional requirements Documents for DCS, PLC, SCADA, ESD/SIS, and Fire & Gas systems.
	Coordinate and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
	Support integration of packaged unit control systems with the main plant control system.
	Provide site engineering support for instrument installation, tubing, cabling, terminations, and grounding.
	Supervise loop checks, calibration, functional testing, and pre-commissioning activities.
	System Integration Services
	Support commissioning and start-up, punch list closure, and handover documentation.
	Prepare as-built documentation and turnover packages.
	Manage the engineering documents in your discipline through the document control system (MDR/TQ/RFI tracking).
	Support man-hour estimates, progress reporting, and management of scope changes.
	Enforce HSE, quality on all assigned activities.


Project Design:


	Develops and supervise the draughting of Drawings for Specific Projects.
	Develops Bill of Quantities for Projects from shop drawings and from Consultant / Clients drawings for purpose of tendering.


Project Planning:


	Prepares Budget and time schedules for Projects.
	Prepares Project Design Drawings, Shop Drawings and “As Built Drawing.
	Ensure Proper handling of Company Tools and Equipment as well as Maintenance.
	Reads and understands Contract Documents.


Project/Site Coordination:


	Provides Technical Evaluation of Sub-contractors and commercial inputs.
	Attends site meetings with Clients and other Contractors on site.
	Ensures compliance with and implementation of Quality Control procedure for all incoming materials.
	Delegates authority and ensures subordinates are adequately engaged.
	Support Commercial Departments for inputs in Tendering with relevant inputs.
	Supervise the Technician and Sub Contractors on site during Installation.
	Ensures cordial relationships with Clients.


Requirements


	B.Eng/B.Sc in Instrumentation and Control, Electrical/Electronics.
	Minimum 10 years of post qualification experience in the Oil and Gas Sector and/or Power Transmission/Distribution Sector.
	Membership of COREN, NSE or Relevant Professional Body will be of added advantage.
	Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel, Word, Project, Power Point, Visio, PDF; knowledge of use of AutoCAD will be of added advantage.
	Experience with upstream, midstream, or downstream facilities (flow stations, gas plants, pipelines, terminals, refineries, or offshore platforms).
	Experience working with international clients and IOCs/NOCs is highly desirable.


Application Closing Date: 6th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

{

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Service Desk Analyst",
  "description": "Unified Payment Services Limited is a group of companies with services including Banking, Payment Scheme, Financial Technology, Digital Commerce, Value Added Service, Payment Solutions, Software Solutions, etc. Unified Payments is a principal member or licensed acquirer of American Express, Mastercard, Visa and UnionPay; and has been instrumental in building the infrastructure that supports Nigeria&rsquo;s modern payments ecosystem.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Service Desk Analyst

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Objectives


	To provide effective first-line technical support to employees and users by receiving, logging, diagnosing, resolving, and escalating technology-related incidents and service requests.
	The role ensures timely resolution of IT issues, optimal user experience, system availability, and adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), IT policies, and service management standards.


Duties &amp; Responsibilities
Service Desk Operations:


	Serve as the first point of contact for IT-related issues and requests.
	Log, prioritize, track, and resolve tickets within agreed SLAs.


Incident Management:


	Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and application issues.
	Escalate complex incidents to the appropriate technical teams and follow up to resolution.


Service Request Management:


	Process standard IT service requests and ensure timely completion.
	Maintain accurate records of requests and resolutions.


Reporting &amp; Documentation:


	Prepare service desk reports covering incidents, requests, resolution times, and transaction reporting &amp; analysis.
	Maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge bases, and support documentation.


Customer &amp; Stakeholder Support:


	Provide professional and customer-focused technical support to external and internal customers
	Collaborate with other Technology teams and external partners to resolve issues.


Compliance &amp; Continuous Improvement:


	Ensure compliance with IT policies, security requirements, and ITSM processes.
	Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to enhance service quality and user experience.


Job Requirements
Education:


	OND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.


Experience:


	Minimum of 2 years of experience in IT service desk, technical support, help desk, or a related IT support role.
	Experience working with an IT Service Management (ITSM) platform and ticketing systems.
	Experience providing first-level technical support in a corporate or enterprise environment.


Others:


	Strong understanding of CBN PTSA Guidelines, and payment industry regulations.
	Hands-on experience with POS terminal management systems, switching platforms, and settlement systems.
	Proven ability to manage large transaction volumes, reconciliation, and dispute processes.

Service Desk Analyst Job at Unified Payment Services Limited




        
    

        
        Unified Payment Services Limited is a group of companies with services including Banking, Payment Scheme, Financial Technology, Digital Commerce, Value Added Service, Payment Solutions, Software Solutions, etc. Unified Payments is a principal member or licensed acquirer of American Express, Mastercard, Visa and UnionPay; and has been instrumental in building the infrastructure that supports Nigeria’s modern payments ecosystem.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Service Desk Analyst

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Objectives
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	To provide effective first-line technical support to employees and users by receiving, logging, diagnosing, resolving, and escalating technology-related incidents and service requests.
	The role ensures timely resolution of IT issues, optimal user experience, system availability, and adherence to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs), IT policies, and service management standards.


Duties & Responsibilities
Service Desk Operations:


	Serve as the first point of contact for IT-related issues and requests.
	Log, prioritize, track, and resolve tickets within agreed SLAs.


Incident Management:


	Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and application issues.
	Escalate complex incidents to the appropriate technical teams and follow up to resolution.


Service Request Management:


	Process standard IT service requests and ensure timely completion.
	Maintain accurate records of requests and resolutions.


Reporting & Documentation:


	Prepare service desk reports covering incidents, requests, resolution times, and transaction reporting & analysis.
	Maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge bases, and support documentation.


Customer & Stakeholder Support:


	Provide professional and customer-focused technical support to external and internal customers
	Collaborate with other Technology teams and external partners to resolve issues.


Compliance & Continuous Improvement:


	Ensure compliance with IT policies, security requirements, and ITSM processes.
	Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to enhance service quality and user experience.


Job Requirements
Education:


	OND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.


Experience:


	Minimum of 2 years of experience in IT service desk, technical support, help desk, or a related IT support role.
	Experience working with an IT Service Management (ITSM) platform and ticketing systems.
	Experience providing first-level technical support in a corporate or enterprise environment.


Others:


	Strong understanding of CBN PTSA Guidelines, and payment industry regulations.
	Hands-on experience with POS terminal management systems, switching platforms, and settlement systems.
	Proven ability to manage large transaction volumes, reconciliation, and dispute processes.
